_help: New herbs and materials. An item's tag is Gameplay.Inventory.Consumable.<id> (or Materials.<id>), so pick an id the game doesn't have. 'like' borrows what a game item does, its icon and its badge; 'recipe' is what the medicine cat wants for one; 'give' is how many you start with (once). docs/SDK.md, 'New items', lists every key.
